test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

She said she was seeing her brother the following day.

options.text: She said, "I should see my brother tomorrow.”
She said, “I was seeing my brother tomorrow.”
She says, “I will see my brother tomorrow.”
She said, “ I am seeing my brother tomorrow.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said she was seeing her brother the following day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"She was seeing" becomes "I am seeing"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is converted to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "was seeing" is changed to "am seeing" as the reporting verb "said" indicates present intent.
 
 
 
• **"the following day" becomes "tomorrow"**
 
 
• The time phrase "the following day" in indirect speech is converted to "tomorrow" in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period inside the quotation marks.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said, ‘I am seeing my brother tomorrow.’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said, 'I should see my brother tomorrow.'" – Incorrect modal verb ("should" instead of "am").
 
• **Option 2:** "She said, 'I was seeing my brother tomorrow.'" – Incorrect verb tense ("was seeing" instead of "am seeing").
 
• **Option 3:** "She says, 'I will see my brother tomorrow.'" – Incorrect reporting verb ("says" instead of "said"), changing the tense.
